# <!--name-->Claude Review<!--/name-->

<!--description-->
Reviews a pull request's Terraform plans (Atlantis, Spacelift), Helm diff and code with Claude and returns the review as an output. Claude has no GitHub write access here; pair with claude-review/post to publish the result.
<!--/description-->

Most repositories should call the reusable workflow instead:
see [`.github/workflows/docs/claude-review.md`](../.github/workflows/docs/claude-review.md).
Use this action directly when you need your own trigger, gate or concurrency rules.

## Inputs

<!--inputs-->
| Name                  | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                         | Required | Default               |
|-----------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------|-----------------------|
| `anthropic_api_key`   | Anthropic API key.                                                                                                                                                                                                  | `true`   | ` `                   |
| `pr_number`           | Pull request number to review.                                                                                                                                                                                      | `true`   | ` `                   |
| `github_token`        | GitHub token with contents:read and pull-requests:read. Nothing in this action writes to GitHub.                                                                                                                    | `false`  | `${{ github.token }}` |
| `trigger`             | What started this review: on-demand, atlantis-plan, spacelift-plan, helm-diff or pull-request. Plan triggers wait `debounce_seconds` so continuation comments can land.                                             | `false`  | `on-demand`           |
| `atlantis_bot`        | GitHub login of the Atlantis app that posts plan comments.                                                                                                                                                          | `false`  | `atlantis-admin[bot]` |
| `spacelift_bot`       | GitHub login of the Spacelift app that posts run comments.                                                                                                                                                          | `false`  | `spacelift-io[bot]`   |
| `helm_diff_artifact`  | Name of an artifact in this workflow run containing `diff.log` from diff-rendered-charts. When empty, the Helm diff is read from the PR comments instead.                                                           | `false`  | ` `                   |
| `extra_prompt`        | Repository-specific review instructions appended to the base prompt.                                                                                                                                                | `false`  | ` `                   |
| `model`               | Claude model. Empty uses the claude-code-action default.                                                                                                                                                            | `false`  | ` `                   |
| `fallback_model`      | Fallback model if the primary is unavailable. Empty uses the default.                                                                                                                                               | `false`  | ` `                   |
| `budget`              | Maximum spend per review in USD.                                                                                                                                                                                    | `false`  | `6.00`                |
| `debounce_seconds`    | Seconds to wait before collecting context when triggered by a plan comment.                                                                                                                                         | `false`  | `45`                  |
| `skill`               | Run a Claude Code skill instead of the built-in plan/Helm review, e.g. "/workgroups review {pr}". "{pr}" is replaced with the PR number. The skill must come from the checked-out repository or from `plugin_dirs`. | `false`  | ` `                   |
| `plugin_dirs`         | Newline-separated local directories of Claude Code plugins to load (`--plugin-dir`). Hooks and MCP server definitions inside them are removed before loading; CI runs skills only.                                  | `false`  | ` `                   |
| `extra_allowed_tools` | Newline-separated permission rules added to the allow list, e.g. "Bash(git log:*)" or "WebFetch(domain:example.com)". Write, Edit and AskUserQuestion stay denied.                                                  | `false`  | ` `                   |
| `comment_marker`      | Identifier embedded as `<!-- <marker> -->` in the posted comment. Callers running several reviews on one repository give each its own marker so they do not collapse each other.                                    | `false`  | `claude-review`       |
<!--/inputs-->

## Outputs

<!--outputs-->
| Name     | Description                                                                                                                          |
|----------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `review` | Single-line JSON for claude-review/post: {pr_number, head_sha, state, description, body, error}. Empty when the PR was not reviewed. |
<!--/outputs-->

## Requirements

- Check out the pull request head into the workspace before this step.
- Run it in a job whose token is read-only (`contents: read`, `pull-requests: read`).
- Pass the `review` output to [`claude-review/post`](./post/README.md) in a separate job with
  `pull-requests: write`.

## What Claude sees

The action fetches, with fixed queries, the PR metadata and changed files, non-minimized
Atlantis and Spacelift comments, the Helm diff (artifact or comment), kubeconform failures,
checks and human discussion into `$RUNNER_TEMP/claude-review/`. HTML comments are stripped from
fetched bodies. The prompt in [`prompt.md`](./prompt.md) treats all of it as untrusted data.
Repo-level `.claude/` and `.mcp.json` are removed from the checkout before Claude runs. Claude
returns structured output matching [`schema.json`](./schema.json); the comment is rendered from
that, not from free text.

## Example Usage

```yaml
- uses: actions/checkout@<sha>
  with:
    ref: refs/pull/${{ github.event.issue.number }}/head
    persist-credentials: false
- id: review
  uses: mozilla/deploy-actions/claude-review@<sha>
  with:
    anthropic_api_key: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
    pr_number: ${{ github.event.issue.number }}
    trigger: on-demand
    atlantis_bot: ${{ vars.ATLANTIS_GITHUB_USER }}
```
